maddeler.e:
استظهرا (form X)
# اِسْتَظْهَرَا (istaẓharā) /is.taðˤ.ha.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# اُسْتُظْهِرَا (ustuẓhirā) /us.tuðˤ.hi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# اِسْتَظْهِرَا (istaẓhirā) /is.taðˤ.hi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
